content.tex: INVESTIGATION REVERSE DIFFERENCES
This investigation looks at what happens when you reverse the digits of a number and then find the difference between the new number and the original number. This is called the reverse difference.
STEP 1 Write down a 2-digit number. STEP 2 Reverse the digits of the number. STEP 3 Find the positive difference between the two numbers.
Example 1 Example 2
STEP 1 Write a number 52 STEP \(1 13\) STEP 2 Reverse the digits 25 STEP \(2 31\) STEP 3 Find the difference \(52\begin{pmatrix}25 & = & 27 & STEP & 3 & 31\end{pmatrix}13 = 18\)

parts.text: (b) A 4-digit number has first digit 7 and last digit 5. Its reverse difference is 2178. Find the connection between the middle two digits of the 4-digit number. ..................................................................................................................................................... [4]

ms.label: 4(b)
ms.text:
Second digit minus third digit is 2 oe
or b – c = 2
AND
One correct calculation with b – c = 2
e.g. 7 3 1 5
− 5 1 3 7
2 1 7 8
Two further correct calculations with b – c = 2
OR
Substitution of a = 7 and d = 5
e.g. 999 × 7 + 90b – 90c – 999 × 5 = 2178
Collection of terms
90b – 90c = 2178 – 6993 + 4995 or better
OR
7 – 5 = 2
2178 – 2 × 999
180 ÷ 90 = 2
